title: Evaluation at an original register
statement: Let $R$ be a natural number, let $\rho:\{0,\ldots,R-1\}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $p,oc,tm\in\mathbb{N}$. Extend these register values by assigning $p$, $oc$, and $tm$ to the three additional registers at indices $R$, $R+1$, and $R+2$. For every original register $r<R$, the extended assignment gives it the value $\rho(r)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns natural-number values to the first $R$ registers
